comments.author: @BP_PE90
comments.text: I always have trouble discerning when people say Airbnb if they are referring to rental houses by and large or specifically rentals listed on the Airbnb platform. At many of the best beaches in my state and neighboring states, there are only rental houses and no hotels are at the beach. I prefer staying at a house at a quieter beach versus staying at a huge hotel and dealing with the crowds.
